secoes.titulo: Overall Raw Mean (Risk and Well-being Factors)
secoes.tituloPrincipal: Overall Raw Mean (Risk and Well-being Factors)

tituloPorIdioma.en-US: Overall Raw Mean (Risk and Well-being Factors)

secoes.corpo:
Likert Scale: Responses quantified from 1 to 5.

Overall Raw Mean: Unlike isolated interpretations of subscales recommended for in-depth corporate consulting, this web screening extracts a simple average of all answered questions in the core blocks to provide an overall alert overview (where higher values indicate greater presence of the sum of demands, stressors, or reported dissatisfactions).

Thresholds (Tertiles): ≤ 2.33 (Green/Favorable), 2.34 to 3.65 (Yellow/Caution) and ≥ 3.66 (Red/Risk).

textoCompleto:
Health and Well-being at Work Survey (COPSOQ III)

International Standard Version of the Copenhagen Psychosocial Questionnaire.
Modernized instrument for assessing work organization and psychosocial risks, suitable for NR-1.

A. Statements about you and your workplace
A.1: In which area/department are you (mainly) employed?

A.2: What is your gender?

A.3: What is your age?

A.4: Which profession do you belong to (current job)?

A.5: Do the following items apply to you?

A.6: Questions about your working time. Do you work...

B. Statements about work and activity
B.1: The following questions refer to the demands of your work (Part 1).

B.1: Demands of your work (Part 2).

B.2: The following questions refer to the balance between work and personal life. To what extent do you agree?

B.3: The following questions refer to how much influence and freedom you have in your work.

B.4: Development opportunities and meaning of work. (Part 1)

B.5: Development opportunities and meaning of work. (Part 2)

B.6: Now some questions about the arrangements and procedures in your work.

B.7: To what extent would you say that your immediate supervisor...

B.8: The following questions refer to your relationship with your colleagues and your supervisor.

B.8a: The next questions are not about your own work, but about the workplace as a whole.

B.8b: The following questions refer to your physical work environment:

B.9: Are you worried about...

B.10: In the last 12 months, how often have you thought about...

B.11: Regarding your work in general. How satisfied are you with...

Now some questions about work and health

B.12: Your health status: If you rate the best conceivable health status as 10 points and the worst as 0 points: How many points do you give for your current health status?

B.13: Energy and mental well-being: How often...

B.14: How often do the following statements apply to you?

C. Free Comments

Overall Raw Mean (Risk and Well-being Factors)

Mathematical Evaluation Logic
Likert Scale: Responses quantified from 1 to 5.

Overall Raw Mean: Unlike isolated interpretations of subscales recommended for in-depth corporate consulting, this web screening extracts a simple average of all answered questions in the core blocks to provide an overall alert overview (where higher values indicate greater presence of the sum of demands, stressors, or reported dissatisfactions).

Thresholds (Tertiles): ≤ 2.33 (Green/Favorable), 2.34 to 3.65 (Yellow/Caution) and ≥ 3.66 (Red/Risk).
